title: The Quran: Surah 93, ad-Duha (Morning Light)
author: Tradução inglesa de Talal Itani (ClearQuran)
tradition: Texto sagrado do Islão, século VII
intro: Lição sobre a Surata 93. O texto inglês é a tradução de Talal Itani, reproduzida sem alterações; as notas de língua, perguntas, discussão e escrita são material pedagógico separado, baseado apenas no que o próprio texto diz.

source.title: Quran English Translation: Clear, Pure, Easy to Read Modern English
source.edition: Edition A (uses the word 'Allah' to refer to the Creator)

questions.q: According to verse 3, what did your Lord not do?
options: He did not abandon you or forget
questions.why: O versículo 3 diz: 'Your Lord did not abandon you, nor did He forget.'

questions.q: Verses 6 to 8 are three questions about the past. What do they remind the person of?
options: That he was found in need and was helped
questions.why: O texto diz: 'found you orphaned... wandering... in need', e cada uma é seguida de ajuda.
'Do not mistreat', 'Nor rebuff' e 'But proclaim' são instruções.

questions.q: Which sentence best sums up the passage?
options: A reminder of past care, a promise, and instructions for how to act
questions.why: Há lembrança (versículos 6 a 8), promessa (versículo 5) e instruções (versículos 9 a 11).

B2.discussion: The passage asks the person to remember how he was helped, and then tells him how to treat others. Why might remembering help us treat others well?
B2.writing: Write 80 to 100 words: Say what the three questions in verses 6 to 8 remind the person of.

questions.why: O versículo 2 diz: 'And the night as it settles.'
'Rebuff' é repelir ou rejeitar de forma ríspida.

questions.q: In verses 6 to 8, 'found you orphaned', 'wandering' and 'in need' are each followed by an action. What pattern is clear?
options: Each condition is answered by a matching act of help
Each condition is a question about the future
questions.why: Órfão foi abrigado, errante foi guiado e necessitado foi enriquecido.

questions.q: What does 'Therefore' at the start of verse 9 do?
options: It draws a conclusion: instructions follow from what verses 6 to 8 recall
questions.why: 'Therefore' liga as instruções à lembrança dos versículos anteriores.

questions.q: Which description of the passage is best supported?
options: Morning light and night (1 and 2), reassurance (3 to 5), three questions (6 to 8), instructions (9 to 11)
questions.why: Cada grupo de versículos tem uma função clara.

C1.discussion: Each question in verses 6 to 8 names a condition and then the help that followed. How does this pairing make the reassurance stronger than a general statement would?
C1.writing: Write 120 to 150 words: Explain how verses 9 to 11 follow from verses 6 to 8.

questions.q: Which two phenomena open the passage?
options: Morning light and the night as it settles
questions.why: Os versículos 1 e 2 são 'By the morning light' e 'And the night as it settles'.

questions.q: In verse 5, what does 'and you will be satisfied' add after 'will give you'?
options: A result: the giving ends in satisfaction
questions.why: A frase acrescenta o resultado do que será dado.

questions.q: What do the opening images (morning light, night as it settles) form?
options: A pair of opposites, day and night
questions.why: Luz da manhã e noite a assentar são opostos.

questions.q: Which verse marks the turn from reminder to instruction?
questions.why: O versículo 9 começa com 'Therefore' e inicia as instruções.

options: Reassurance (3 to 5), three paired questions about past care (6 to 8), and three closing instructions (9 to 11), linked by 'Therefore'
questions.why: Cada bloco tem uma função e o 'Therefore' liga o lembrete à instrução.

C2.discussion: The passage moves from reassurance to memory to instruction. What is the effect of making instructions grow out of a reminder of what was received?
C2.writing: Write 150 to 200 words: Analyse how the passage moves from reassurance to instruction, referring to specific verses and words.
